Evidence (single-developer mode, SD2 land-on-green):

Files:
- acquire/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/acquire/sherlock.scala (portable adapter)
- acquire/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/acquire/SherlockAnnotationsSuite.scala (13 courts)
- embed-bench/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/bench/sherlock/SherlockRecallMapping.scala (bridge + CSV reader + terminal runner)
- embed-bench/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/bench/sherlock/SherlockRecallMappingSuite.scala (5 courts incl. end-to-end)

Gate (LocallyObserved, warm tree, exact command in tmp/gate-full.log):
sbt "acquireJVM/test; acquireJS/test; acquireNative/test; embedBench/test; scalafmtCheckAll"
GATE_EXIT=0; acquire Passed: Total 132 on JVM, JS, and Native; embedBench Passed: Total 91; zero [error] lines; scalafmt last and clean.

Mutation proof (SD1): deleting the seconds*ticksPerSecond crosswalk mapping compiled and killed exactly three named assertions (crosswalk identity, zero-duration instant tick, extent-escape refusal) while the ten sibling tests stayed green; restored, suite back to 13/13. Discriminating kill, not blanket red.

Real replay (diagnostic, data external to git in tmp/):
runMain storymodel4s.bench.sherlock.sherlockRecallMap on the admitted 1000-row TSV (hash verified against inputAnnotation.sha256 in-process) x recall NN01 (1616 words): 101 recall units, all 101 with a MAP source anchor, 50 scenes grouped, inference 1458 ms. Spot checks show real signal ("he wakes up" -> gunfire nightmare 39-40 s part A; "walking through a park" -> Russell Square limp walk 470-480 s part A). External mass 0.90: lexical-only channel, uncalibrated, exactly the diagnostic-baseline claim of the PRD. Report written to tmp/sherlock-recall-NN01.tsv (local-sensitive, not committed).

What this does not establish: no calibrated memory measure, no semantic channel, no TopicHmmEvent30 population, no alias-map replay receipt, no E0 output bundle or report; recall-side admission/disclosure remains open. Deferred per bead body.
